image_description: An open ring binder lying flat on a white surface. The left side shows the interior of a dark green cover. The right side contains a stack of papers held by a metal 3-ring mechanism. The top paper features a graphic design with text that appears to be mirrored or gibberish, including the word 'JAPAN' reversed and other illegible characters.

artifact_observations.location: Printed insert on the right side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the document insert is nonsensical and mirrored (e.g., 'JAPAN' is reversed). While physically possible if a mirror were involved, in AI generation this is a hallmark artifact of failed text rendering.

The metal rings appear slightly fused into the paper holes and lack distinct mechanical separation at the hinge points. The geometry is plausible but lacks the crisp engineering details of a real metal mechanism.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge of the green cover
artifact_observations.reasoning: The left edge of the open cover seems to warp slightly rather than maintaining a perfectly straight rigid line, suggesting minor geometric instability.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings. Mirrored text is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, verify if the ring mechanism's connection to the spine looks physically grounded or if it floats/fuses.
